sections.content: As a synthesis of Hardiman’s account: don’t assume every story must fit the standard article format, or make urgent storytelling wait on ordinary roadmap processes. For live coverage, teams may need to make timely calls with editors about the most truthful, accurate, and accessible experience, even without all the usual data. Then they can identify promising one-off experiments and test whether those formats can scale.
